title: Donald Trump Jr. set to speak at ALGOP Trump Victory Dinner in Birmingham tomorrow evening - Yellowhammer News
text:
The Alabama Republican Party is welcoming Donald Trump Jr. to Birmingham on Thursday evening for the organization’s much-anticipated Trump Victory Dinner. The president’s son will be delivering the headlining remarks at the event.
“This dinner is bigger than politics—it’s about celebrating our conservative victories and showing unwavering support for President Trump as he fights to restore America,” said ALGOP Chairman John Wahl.
“The Trump Family and Alabama have always had a strong bond, and we are proud to continue that tradition. As President Trump and his administration work tirelessly to defend our nation, the Alabama Republican Party remains committed to standing with him every step of the way. This event is going to be an amazing opportunity for Republicans to gather together and celebrate President Donald Trump’s victory with Don Jr.”
RELATED: Trump fires up crowd at record-breaking ALGOP event
The organization offered additional information on the event in a separate release.
“We expect several special guests for our Trump Victory Dinner and are especially honored to welcome President Trump’s oldest son as our keynote speaker. As a passionate defender of conservative values, Don Jr. brings a unique perspective on the Trump family, the early days of President Trump’s second administration, and the battles ahead to secure our nation’s future. You won’t want to miss his visit to Alabama!”
Don Jr.’s visit to Alabama comes after his sister in law, Lara Trump, spoke at the Alabama Republican Party’s 2024 Summer Dinner while his father, President Trump, delivered the keynote address at the organization’s 2023 Summer Dinner.
The Trump Victory Dinner will be at the BJCC North Exhibition Hall (2100 Richard Arrington Blvd North Birmingham, AL 35203), beginning with a reception at 6 p.m. and dinner at 7 p.m.
Austen Shipley is the News Director for Yellowhammer News. You can follow him on X @ShipleyAusten
